teacher: Causal, public-prefix-only structured contrast: at ordinary events choose the exact F60 fixed online successor; at public junction events choose the legal successor maximizing public retained role-path coverage (sum of squared hop lengths)/36, retained distinct endpoints/24 and junction endpoint support (event endpoint present in lossless retained memory).
candidate_target: maximize 0.45*min(1,sum(len(role_codes)^2)/72) + 0.30*min(1,unique_retained_endpoints/24) + 0.25*(number of current event endpoints present after)/2 at public junction; otherwise select exactly frozen F60 successor
loss: For each current legal candidate different from teacher-selected target, form source-feature difference target minus alternative, push pairwise signed margin 0.1 with deterministic 3 epochs at lr 0.025. No future-question, no source-private truth, no future public events.
train_order: ascending seed then family then index, unchanged
source_training: synthetic negative seed only until prereg method passes before FIT TRAIN first-use
